lines.t: Blessed are the ones who made it out
Called Your name with no more doubt
Hearts laid down, truth in their cry
Left it all just to follow the light
No turning back, no holding on
Everything they were is gone
Blessed escape, they found the way
Called on Your name and didn’t stray
Gave up the world, chose what is true
Now their reward is life in You
Sincere voices in the night
Reaching out for what is right
All they had, they let it fall
Just to answer to the call
No disguise, no in-between
Only truth in what it means
Blessed escape, they found the way
Called on Your name and didn’t stray
Gave up the world, chose what is true
Now their reward is life in You
They found the way…
They found the truth…
They gave it all…
And now they live in You…
